description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_CSSDefinition which manages CSS attribute definitions and setup for HTMLPurifier, including various CSS properties, proprietary extensions, and configuration-based adjustments.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_CSSDefinition
classes.description: Manages CSS attribute definitions and setup process for the purifier, including various CSS properties, proprietary extensions, and config-dependent features.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Initializes CSS property definitions based on the configuration, setting up allowed styles, proprietary extensions, tricky, and trusted setup, and applying important decorators.

methods.name: doSetupProprietary
methods.description: Defines proprietary CSS properties such as Internet Explorer scrollbar colors and vendor-specific attributes based on configuration.

methods.name: doSetupTricky
methods.description: Sets up CSS properties considered tricky or non-standard, configuring properties like display, visibility, overflow, and opacity.

methods.name: doSetupTrusted
methods.description: Defines trusted CSS properties related to positioning and z-index, respecting configuration limits.

methods.name: setupConfigStuff
methods.description: Adjusts the info array based on the CSS allowed and forbidden properties specified in the configuration, and emits warnings for unsupported properties.
